meta.name: show-your-work
meta.description: Screenshot changed blog pages and host images on GitHub gist for PR descriptions. Use after content changes are committed and before creating a PR. Auto-detects changed pages from git diff against main.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 截图博客变更并上传到 GitHub Gist 用于 PR 描述
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次提交 PR 前都要手动截图并上传图片
copy.tagline_en: Screenshot changed blog pages and host on GitHub Gist for PR descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually screenshot and upload images before every PR

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动检测你修改的博客页面，截图（桌面和手机版），上传到 GitHub Gist，并生成可直接粘贴到 PR 描述中的 Markdown 表格。
howto.when: 在内容修改提交后、创建 PR 之前使用。Claude 会自动对比当前分支与 main 分支，找出变更的页面。

say.text: 帮我截图我改过的页面，准备 PR 描述。
say.note: 自动检测变更页面并截图上传。

say.text: 截图 /about 页面并生成 PR 描述。
say.note: 指定具体页面进行截图。
截图后直接更新指定 PR 的描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically detects changed blog pages, takes desktop and mobile screenshots, uploads them to a GitHub Gist, and produces a Markdown table ready for a PR description.
howto.when_en: Use after content changes are committed and before creating a PR. Claude auto-detects changed pages by comparing the current branch against main.

say_en.text: Screenshot my changed pages and prepare PR description.
say_en.note: Auto-detects changed pages, screenshots, and uploads.

say_en.text: Screenshot the /about page and generate PR description.
say_en.note: Specifies a particular page to screenshot.
Screenshots and updates the specified PR's description.
